task: Lyrics G3 — Genius roster expansion: post-fetch ingest + verification waves

agents.name: G3 Fetch Auditor
agents.task:
MY TASK: 1. Read ORCHESTRATION/lyrics_g3/ledger.md and Genious_lyrics_extractor/roster_g3.json for the expected 16-artist roster and pinned ids.
2. Read every Genious_lyrics_extractor/status/*.json status file (one per artist) — verify status=done for all 16 and record songs count per artist.
3. Walk the corpus tree at D:\Projects\Music-AI-Toolshop\data\toolshop\lyrics\genius\ — list all new category dirs (<artist>-solo/-featured/-duo/-trio, other-collab) and count *.json per dir (exclude _index.json/_dedup_log.json).
4. Spot-check 3 random new song JSONs per cohort for: genius_song_id populated (non-null), correct primary_artist, sectioned lyrics array non-empty.
5. Flag: any artist not done, any genius_song_id=null, any folder whose name does not match a roster folder, any cross-cohort collab folder.
6. Report per-artist totals + grand total of new songs. Verdict line: INGEST READY or FETCH INCOMPLETE (with the blocking list).

SCOPE: D:\Projects\Music-AI-Toolshop\data\toolshop\lyrics\genius\ and Genious_lyrics_extractor/status/ in the lyrics-g3 worktree

OUTPUT: Write your handoff to: ORCHESTRATION/lyrics_g3/wave1/g3_fetch_audit_handoff.md

- Read-only. Do NOT modify any files.
- Do NOT run the fetcher, index builder, or build_database.
- Corpus root is the SHARED canonical path (data/toolshop under the main repo), not the worktree's data dir.

read summaries and targeted sections only.

agents.name: G3 DB Ingester
agents.task:
MY TASK: 1. Precondition: wave-1 handoff verdict must be INGEST READY; if not, stop and write that in your handoff.
2. Record pre-ingest baseline first: open D:\Projects\Music-AI-Toolshop\data\toolshop\lyrics\lyrics.db read-only and capture songs total, genius-pro count (baseline 1,425), and count per genre_cohort.
3. Rebuild the unified index: run the index builder from toolshop.lyricsdb (build_unified_index) over the genius corpus root, or the equivalent toolshop CLI lyrics subcommand — check toolshop/cli.py for the exact entry point. Write _index.json + _dedup_log.json at the corpus root.
4. Ingest incrementally: toolshop.lyricsdb.build_database(root=<genius corpus>, db_path=<canonical db>, corpus='genius-pro', incremental=True). Prefer the toolshop CLI equivalent if it exists.
5. Use the venv interpreter: D:\Projects\Music-AI-Toolshop\.venv\Scripts\python.exe. Use python -u for long runs; absolute paths only.
6. Post-ingest verify: songs total increased by exactly the wave-1 audited new-song count; genius-pro = 1,425 + new; cohort counts for drill_trap and pop both grew; zero NEW rows with NULL cohort beyond pre-existing baseline.
7. Record all counts (before/after) in the handoff.

SCOPE: Genious_lyrics_extractor/, toolshop/ in the lyrics-g3 worktree; canonical db at D:\Projects\Music-AI-Toolshop\data\toolshop\lyrics\lyrics.db

OUTPUT: Write your handoff to: ORCHESTRATION/lyrics_g3/wave2/g3_db_ingest_handoff.md

CONSTRAINTS:
- Modify only: corpus _index.json/_dedup_log.json, lyrics.db (via build_database), ORCHESTRATION artifacts.
- incremental=True only — never a non-incremental build (it deletes the corpus).
- Do NOT commit; the orchestrator owns commits.

read summaries and targeted sections only.

HANDOFF: When done, return the file path and a 1-2 sentence summary.

agents.name: G3 Verifier
agents.task:
MY TASK: 1. Read wave-1 and wave-2 handoffs plus ORCHESTRATION/lyrics_g3/ledger.md for claimed counts.
2. NULL-cohort audit: query lyrics.db for genius-pro rows whose folder matches a new G3 roster artist but genre_cohort IS NULL — expected zero except deliberate unmapped folders; list any found.
3. Misattribution spot-check: for each new artist folder, sample 5 titles and confirm primary_artist plausibly matches (artist name or known variant in roster_g3.json).
4. Cohort correctness: confirm each new artist's solo rows carry the cohort assigned in roster_g3.json (drill_trap or pop).
5. Release-safety smoke: verify any release/export tooling excludes corpus='genius-pro' (release_ok=no) — check toolshop release/export code paths rather than producing an export.
6. Test rerun: D:\Projects\Music-AI-Toolshop\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest D:\Projects\Music-AI-Toolshop-wt-lyrics-g3\tests\test_lyrics_genius_roster.py -v — must be green; also run the pre-existing lyrics test subset touched by lyricsdb.py changes.
7. Handoff: VERDICT pass/fail per check + any follow-up items.

SCOPE: lyrics.db (read-only queries), roster_g3.json, tests/ in the lyrics-g3 worktree

OUTPUT: Write your handoff to: ORCHESTRATION/lyrics_g3/wave3/g3_verify_handoff.md
